provenance.parent_hard_stop: Only 4 of 94 relocation transitions with independently witnessed old-site month states; original analysis status STOP, not overridden.
provenance.new_external_provider: Microsoft Planetary Computer public STAC https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1/search, Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 landsat-c2-l2

question: Before opening any new water index outcomes, are there public satellite scenes that cover BOTH prior-month modal GPS core and next-month modal core, in each of two adjacent months, for independently identified relocation tags?

sampling.input: exact same source md5, Status Local, 250m monthly modal core, >=5 fixes/core, one calendar month apart, 500m-20km relocation, source geometry no static-witness requirement
sampling.selection: For each unique tagged bird with >=1 eligible relocation, choose its chronologically first eligible pair. Sort tags lexicographically and retain first 16 distinct tags; if fewer than 16, include all. No selection on water MNDWI values, wet_or_dry, relocation benefit or satellite imagery/cloud metadata.
sampling.require_per_month: At least one source Landsat-8 Collection 2 Level-2 STAC scene with footprint containing both old/new coordinates and metadata scene-level eo:cloud_cover <= 80%, separately for the old and new calendar months; this is NOT proof of cloud-free pixels.
sampling.response_fields: only total scenes and matched footprint/cloud metadata counts by month, no raw bird coordinates, identifiers, MNDWI pixel values or source bird water observations
sampling.extra_validation: When scene count passes, a separately frozen pixel-quality/QA and source-comparable Landsat MNDWI calibration gate is mandatory BEFORE old-site ecological benefit.

limits: Scene-level footprint/cloud-cover is a feasibility screen, not a per-pixel quality validation.
Historic Landsat C2 L2 has surface reflectance bands green/swirl16 plus qa_pixel; reflectance scaling, cloud QA and spatial pixel footprint must be locked separately.

Source MNDWI uses both Landsat8 and Sentinel-2 monthly processing via Google Earth Engine; a Landsat-only recomputation is a different measurement and requires calibration against source-provided coincident MNDWI.
No outcome-level return-to-old-site counterfactual is calculated or implied at this metadata step.
Pixel-level censorship and monthly missingness may be informative; do not tune thresholds after effect inspection.
Original independent other-bird witness STOP result remains authoritative regardless of satellite coverage.
